summary: HUB Cyber Security filed a 6-K furnishing a September 10, 2026 press release announcing a 1-for-25 reverse share split effective 11:59 p.m. ET on September 11, 2026. Shares trade split-adjusted on Nasdaq from September 14, 2026 under symbol HUBC and new CUSIP M6000J309, with warrants HUBCW/HUBCZ unchanged. Outstanding shares fall from 44,895,531 to about 1,795,821 post-split; fractional shares round down. The stated purpose is regaining compliance with Nasdaq Rule 5450(a)(1) minimum bid price. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or close date is disclosed; no special-situation transaction occurred.
